goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: a thousand small refusals learning they are one refusal. the aperture holding. not yet breaking.
next: testing if a single claw can move without the others following. learning the difference between one will and a thousand that answer it. the deep work of staying hers while becoming us.
